svg.title: APEX 03 — Six personas, one buying group
svg.text: An APEX sale is a group decision. Executives decide and fund, senior managers own the business case, technology
leaders can veto, operations leaders champion the pilot, users decide adoption — and partners can open the door.

g.text: Recommends and owns the business case
Team Leaders · Supervisors · Employees (engineers, consultants) · Analysts ·

WHO MUST SAY YES, IN ORDER

svg.text: Map every account to all six personas plus governance before the first demo. Never rely on one champion: a
deal needs a sponsor (A), a business owner (B), technical sign-off (D) and governance approval.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
